verdict.rationale: Cake ships an MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) query live cap table data and answer questions about shareholders, vesting, option pool headroom, SAFEs and notes in plain English — a genuine AI-insight capability tied to the product's data. However, this is read-only Q&A via external AI clients rather than a built-in in-product AI feature generating proactive suggestions or recommendations. Missing for 10: native in-app AI chat/insights UI, proactive suggestion generation (vs. reactive Q&A only), and independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration's quality.
